neighbors.identifier: DOI 10.1007/s10278-018-0148-x (PMID 30478479, PMC6646498) — Yune et al., J Digit Imaging 2019
neighbors.establishing_passage: The class activation maps showed that the model mostly focused on the 2nd and 3rd metacarpal base or thumb sesamoid in women, and distal radioulnar joint, distal radial physis and epiphysis, or 3rd metacarpophalangeal joint in men... radiologists reviewed 70 cases... but they could not find any patterns that distinguish the two sexes.

RoentMod, a counterfactual image editing framework that generates realistic chest radiographs with user-specified and synthetic pathology while maintaining the original anatomical features. Deep learning models for CXR interpretation are vulnerable to shortcut learning, where spurious correlations drive decision-making.

neighbors.identifier: J Clin Med 2024;13(7):1904 (MDPI) — Sex Differentiation of Trabecular Bone Structure Based on Textural Analysis of Pelvic Radiographs
neighbors.establishing_passage: Assessed sex determination from trabecular bone structures in the pelvic region, analyzing digital radiographs of 343 patients using textural parameters.

neighbors.identifier: DOI 10.3390/jcm14165888 (PMC12387138) — Opportunistic Detection of CKD Using CT-Based Measurements of Kidney Volume and Perirenal Fat, J Clin Med 2025
neighbors.establishing_passage: KV and PrFT emerged as independent predictors of CKD, forming the basis of a simplified model with potential for opportunistic clinical application (kidney volume OR 0.249, 95% CI 0.146-0.422; test AUC 0.894).

neighbors.identifier: DOI 10.1186/s12880-025-01995-5 — Quantitative renal surface nodularity and renal dysfunction progression, BMC Medical Imaging 2025
neighbors.establishing_passage: Automated pipeline (renal segmentation, edge extraction, surface curve fitting) computing three roughness metrics on CT in 242 hypertensive patients; renal dysfunction progression was independently associated with all three after adjusting for eGFR and renal volume (RSN group HR 5.22).

neighbors.identifier: DOI 10.1038/s41586-026-10181-8 (arXiv:2406.06512) — Blankemeier et al., Merlin, Nature 2026
neighbors.establishing_passage: We fine-tune Merlin for predicting chronic disease onset in otherwise healthy patients within 5-years (six diseases including CKD, mean AUROC ~0.757); the retrieved article text contains no saliency, probing, mediation, or feature-attribution analysis of the CKD head. Supplement not inspected.

neighbors.identifier: DOI 10.1002/pul2.12321 (PMC10719487) — Cajigas et al., Pulmonary Circulation 2023
neighbors.establishing_passage: Quantified pulmonary vascular distribution using BV5 (volume of vessels <5 mm2 cross-sectional area), BV10%, and fractal dimension. The study did not measure cranial/caudal or upper versus lower lung redistribution; the analysis examined vessel volume distribution by size category only, not by anatomical location within the lungs.

neighbors.identifier: arXiv:2008.05975 (Radiology: AI 2021) — Horng, Liao et al., Deep Learning to Quantify Pulmonary Edema in Chest Radiographs
neighbors.establishing_passage: Trained on 369,071 MIMIC-CXR radiographs to grade edema severity on a 4-level ordinal scale (0 none, 1 vascular congestion, 2 interstitial, 3 alveolar), AUC 0.99 for alveolar-vs-none; the abstract includes no analysis of specific radiographic features (such as cephalization or vascular redistribution) that the models use.

neighbors.identifier: Seah et al., Chest Radiographs in Congestive Heart Failure: Visualizing Neural Network Learning, Radiology 2019
neighbors.establishing_passage: GAN-based generative visual rationales on CXR: the correctly trained model highlighted cardiomegaly (75%) and pleural effusions (23.5%); no mention of cephalization or vascular redistribution appears in the article.

neighbors.identifier: DOI 10.1038/s41598-024-72786-1 — Upright vs supine CT pulmonary gradients, Scientific Reports 2024 (risk-flag context, not a neighbor)
neighbors.establishing_passage: The upright craniocaudal perfusion/blood-volume gradient is largely abolished in supine CT and replaced by a ventrodorsal gradient — recorded as a scientific risk flag for the candidate's choice of the cranial axis.

State-of-the-art multi-task and foundation models frequently exploit off-target pathology as shortcuts, limiting their specificity... Incorporating RoentMod-generated counterfactual images during training mitigated this vulnerability. 2D CXR pathology-presence edits; no airway-topology manipulation, no CT.

neighbors.identifier: Medicine (Baltimore) 2018, journals.lww.com/md-journal (ResearchGate PUB 327342125) — The value of the air bronchogram sign on CT image in the identification of different solitary pulmonary consolidation lesions
neighbors.establishing_passage: The length of the involved bronchus with air bronchogram sign, the length of lesion... and the ratio between the length of the involved bronchus and that of the lesion were evaluated (manual measurement, diagnostic use, cancer vs TB vs pneumonia).

neighbors.identifier: DOI 10.1016/j.media.2023.102957 (arXiv:2303.05745) — ATM'22 airway tree modeling benchmark, Medical Image Analysis 2023
neighbors.establishing_passage: The dataset further included a portion of noisy COVID-19 CTs with ground-glass opacity and consolidation; models embedded with the topological continuity enhancement achieved superior performance.

neighbors.identifier: DOI 10.1148/radiol.211914 — Tallam et al., Fully Automated Abdominal CT Biomarkers for Type 2 Diabetes Using Deep Learning, Radiology 2022
neighbors.establishing_passage: Patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus had lower pancreatic CT attenuation and greater visceral fat volume... The best predictors included intrapancreatic fat percentage, pancreatic fractal dimension, plaque severity between the L1 and L4 vertebra levels, average liver CT attenuation, and body mass index (n=8,992).

neighbors.identifier: PMID 38974951 (PMC11226987) — CT Quantitation and Prediction of the Risk of T2DM in Non-Obese Patients with Pancreatic Fatty Infiltration, DMSO 2024
neighbors.establishing_passage: Groups b, c, d, and e had an increased risk of developing diabetes by 3.981, 4.452, 6.037, and 12.937 versus group a; the pancreas-to-spleen attenuation ratio is more objective than other markers.

neighbors.identifier: Academic Radiology 2025, S1076-6332(25)00191-6 — Assessing the Reliability of Pancreatic CT Imaging Biomarkers for Diabetes Prediction: A Dual Center Retrospective Study
neighbors.establishing_passage: Pancreatic imaging biomarkers were measured using three pancreatic segmentation algorithms (TotalSegmentator, nnU-Net, and DM-UNet) to test whether they are resilient to changes in segmentation quality and contrast status for predicting diabetes.
